igstories.title: IG Stories
igstories.description: Upload Instagram story assets — images or short videos (up to 50 MB). Images are resized to 1024px on the shortest side and saved as WebP.

upload.title: Upload stories
upload.hint: Drag and drop or browse — images (PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF, AVIF) or video (MP4, MOV, WebM, max 50 MB)
upload.invalidType: Please choose an image or supported video file.
upload.tooLarge: Video must be 50 MB or smaller.

empty.title: No stories yet
empty.description: Upload your first story image or video to build your content library.

toast.uploadError: Couldn’t upload that file. Try again.
toast.uploadPartial: Some files couldn’t be uploaded. Check your files and try again.
toast.loadError: Couldn’t load your stories. Refresh the page.
toast.deleteError: Couldn’t remove that story. Try again.
